Summary: The HotpotQA dataset paper reports that the BM25 retriever achieved a Hits@10 score of 0.78 on the HotpotQA benchmark. This score indicates the BM25 model's performance in retrieving relevant paragraphs to support multi-hop question answering from a large corpus. The paper also compares this to other models, noting that their proposed model outperforms BM25 in the zero-shot setting.
